notes.title: Teenage Blob's "Paperperson" is out now!
notes.content:
Team Lazerbeam and The Superweaks are beyond stoked to present [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361240/Teenage_Blob_Paperperson__The_First_Single/]Paperperson[/url], a free single from our game-album [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096060/Teenage_Blob/]Teenage Blob![/url] A single-serving slice of Teenage Blob mayhem, Paperperson is a high energy blast through suburbia, featuring smashed windows, cute dogs and hands-free backflips.

Along with a bmx-powered blast of Teen Blob joy, Paperperson gives you a taste of the sweet treats found in the game's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15850/Teenage_Blob_Special_Edition/]Special Edition![/url] Finish the game once to unlock a special live mode, allowing you to sling sandwiches to the sights and sounds of The Superweaks live in concert!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38252455/7f8da3dbd1cdcf65e86cafc88e5d23e031086fee.gif[/img]
Or kick back and enjoy the Paperperson mini-zine! A scaled down version of the 28 page Teenage Blobazine that comes with our Special Edition, this 10 page zine delivers a tasty slice of hand-crafted joy, made by the bands and our talented friends! Check it out for Paperperson lyrics, plus art and words from our rad buds [url=https://www.nannaventer.co.za/]Nanna Venter[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/terrivellmann]Terri Vellmann[/url] and[url=https://baldspotcomics.com/] Greg Labold[/url]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38252455/6e786709770d68939678d289ac3c108a095becba.gif[/img]
We're so happy that this free single is now out! We hope you'll download, enjoy, and share this free gem with someone awesome!

Thanks for being a part of this weird adventure!

Love and high-fives
Team Lazerbeam & The Superweaks
